blurb: Moonshot Museum offers an unprecedented opportunity to get up close and behind the scenes of the 21st century space industry. Pittsburgh's spacecraft are built right here, on view for all guests to witness. Engage with our interactive exhibits highlighting the wide variety of space careers now available in Pittsburgh and beyond.
